prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

(none yet)

(not available)

- choose_path: 86.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 94.6%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 68.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 93.0%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 77.7%, median 395s / mean 5815s

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Archetype & Audio Preview Stage: Redesign the pick_friend screen into a interactive stage layout where users can preview animated pet archetypes and trigger audio sound cues before adoption. (why: Adoption conversion drops sharply to 68.9% with a 89s median duration, indicating friction and indecision during companion selection.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Controls Interactive Mascot Walkthrough: Introduce a guided mascot interaction walkthrough flow on home_intro that demonstrates how to summon, hide, and talk to the pet. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet after completing onboarding.)
2: [choose_path, reorder] Spotlight Layout Journey Reorder: Reorder path choice by setting choose_path layout to spotlight and highlighting path selection cards immediately. (why: choose_path step has a long mean time of 514s, showing users take significant time weighing options before choosing.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Diagnostic Guidance Callout: Display explicit photo quality diagnostic tips on the upload_photos screen to reduce generation failures. (why: Support received emails regarding custom pet generation failing or producing visual glitches.)
4: [sign_in, wait_info] Account Persistence Guard Notice: Add an explicit account sync and pet state protection notice on the sign_in screen. (why: The largest volume of support tickets (8 emails) concerns pets missing or resetting after re-signing in.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Audio Readiness Chime: Enable readiness sound chime and completion status badge during asset rendering on waiting. (why: 3 support tickets reported pet failing to show on desktop or app stalling without clear user signal.)
6: [finish, copy] System Tray Quick Reference Copy: Update onboarding completion messaging on home_intro to clearly explain system tray icon controls. (why: Users report post-onboarding confusion about hiding, showing, and interacting with their desktop pet.)
7: [choose_path, incentive] Path Perk Comparison Badges: Add perk badges comparing Instant Adoption versus Custom Studio on choose_path. (why: The choose_path step takes a mean of 514s, indicating users need immediate clarity on trade-offs.)
8: [adoption, layout] Split Ownership Certificate Presentation: Transform adoption_certificate layout to split style showing pet naming alongside an official stamp badge. (why: The adoption step has the lowest conversion rate (68.9%) in the onboarding funnel.)
